newsitem.title: USA: Vivid Tech names Stephen Raber president.
newsitem.headline: Vivid Tech names Stephen Raber president.

text.p: Stephen Reber has been named president and chief operating officer of Vivid Technologies Inc, effective immediately, the company said Monday.

The appointment was announced by S. David Ellenbogen, who will continue in his role as chairman and chief executive officer of the company. Reber previously held positions of increasing responsibility at Kollmorgen Corp and Perkin-Elmer Corp. Vivid Technologies Inc is a leading supplier of automated explosives detection systems with equipment deployed at 21 airports in 10 countries.
